about.title: Teaching Arabic the way it's actually spoken and examined
about.missionText: We believe learning Arabic should feel achievable and relevant — whether your goal is holding a real conversation or passing your IGCSE exam. We pair every student with instructors who teach with structure, warmth, and accountability.
about.methodologyText: Live, interactive classes over pre-recorded content. Every lesson plan is built around your specific goal, dialect, or exam board — not a one-size-fits-all textbook.
about.whyOnlineText: Online lets us match you with the best-fit instructor regardless of geography, keep class sizes small, and offer flexible scheduling across time zones — without sacrificing the accountability of live teaching.
about.diff1Desc: Purpose-built curricula for conversational learners and IGCSE students — not a generic program stretched to fit both.
about.diff2Desc: Every instructor is a native or near-native Arabic speaker with formal teaching experience.
about.diff3Desc: Classes scheduled around Canada and UAE time zones, with make-up class options.

faqs.title: Frequently asked questions
faqs.sub: Answers to common questions about our programs, scheduling, and class format.

items.q: Do you teach religious studies or Qur'anic Arabic?
items.a: No. Our Conversational Arabic program focuses purely on spoken, everyday Modern Standard Arabic and dialects. This is not a religious studies program.

items.q: What time zones do you teach in?
items.a: Our instructors schedule classes across EST/PST (Canada) and GST (UAE), with flexible slots to accommodate both regions.

items.q: Do I need any prior Arabic knowledge to start?
items.a: Not at all — we offer beginner tracks for both the Conversational and IGCSE Foreign Language programs.

items.q: Which exam boards does the IGCSE program cover?
items.a: Our IGCSE tutors have experience with both Cambridge and Edexcel Arabic syllabuses, for First Language and Foreign Language tracks.
Both options are available for the Conversational program. IGCSE tutoring is primarily one-on-one to align closely with each student's syllabus and pace.

items.q: How do I book a free trial class?
items.a: Use the "Book a Free Trial Class" button anywhere on the site to fill out a short form — we'll follow up to confirm your time.
